text:
cameron: heads up — a new default-deny firewall rule went out to eu-west about 15m ago. multiple GPU nodes failing to decrypt keystore, provisioning stuck. getting KMS access denied in the node boot logs. anyone know who pushed the rule?
priya: seeing the same. nodes in eu-west-2 fail with: "error=KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied; source_ip=10.44.5.12". warmpool join stuck, jobs queued.
li: quick context — the rollout tightened outbound rules to the privatelink proxy CIDR (10.2.0.0/16) and accidentally removed the gpu-subnet allow for 443. the proxy is where we terminate KMS grants.
jeff: @priya can you paste the node log snippet?
priya: sure:
```
2026-03-23T10:29:41Z keystore[1]: attempt=3 err="KMS.Decrypt: AccessDenied" key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:XXXXXXXX:key/abcd
2026-03-23T10:29:41Z keystore[1]: source_ip=10.44.5.12 proxy=10.2.1.8
```
sre-bot: incident INC-5984 opened (severity=P1) — paging ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: jumping in. prioritizing remediation: temporary allow outbound 443 to 10.2.0.0/16 from gpu subnets in eu-west. can we get quick approval to modify SG?
cameron: emergency approved, do it. we need provisioning unblocked. revert once stable.
li: applying temp rule now — aws cli snippet used:
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc123 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.0.0/16 --region eu-west-2
```
li: rule added. watch for nodes rejoining.
priya: nodes are rejoining, warmpool +3, first batch of containers started. provisioning backlog draining. :relieved:
jeff: audit/logging note — there's an ~16m window (10:13–10:29) where keystore decrypt events didn't reach SIEM because the privatelink proxy dropped telemetry when it couldn't reach nodes. we need to backfill.
ops-oncall: logging: opened SIEM ticket SIEM-1321 to request re-ingest of missing keystore decrypt events. tagging retention and priority-high.
cameron: also flagging cost impact — some services autofailed to fallback region so we had cross-region pulls for models for ~40m. rough egress delta ~+$2k. include in postmortem.
li: created a small firewall repo PR that adds an explicit gpu-subnet->keystore-proxy allow and an e2e test for KMS handshake. PR: https://git.internal/rw/firewall/pull/842
priya: also request: we should add a quick preflight check in rollout job that validates keystore reachability from a canary gpu node. saves these manual rollbacks.
jeff: agreed. filing infra-automation ticket INFRA-475.
ops-oncall: incident INC-5984 -> status: mitigated. will keep open until SIEM confirms backfill.
sre-bot: INC-5984 -> resolved by ops-oncall at 2026-03-23T10:47:30Z (post-rollback monitoring)
cameron: thanks everyone. follow-ups: PR review, SIEM backfill confirmation, cost tally in the retro. :thumbsup:
priya: ping me when SIEM confirms, will close thread.
ops-oncall: noted, will update SIEM-1321 and close INC-5984 once we have reingest confirmation.
